articles.summary: OSAKA, Japan, July 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- TryHard Holdings Limited (“TryHard” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: THH), a lifestyle entertainment platform in Japan, today announced that it plans to convene an extraordinary general meeting of shareholders (the “EGM”) at #502 PMOEX Hommachi, 3-1-10
articles.title: TryHard Holdings Limited to Hold Extraordinary General Meeting on July 21, 2026
